super6.race: Hazelton Mountford Insurance Brokers EBF Fillies' Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Karaktar filly. Dam lightly-raced half-sister to winning hurdler/fairly useful chaser (stayed 3¼m) Azrou d'Ex. Hails from an in-form stable and Champion Jockey Sean Bowen booked to ride.

super6.race: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
super6.comment: €60,000 3-y-o, Motivator gelding was very green and shaped with only minor promise when third of 6 in bumper at Taunton (2m, good) on debut back in March but can't be dismissed given connections now returning following a breathing operation.

super6.race: Denis O'Connell Memorial Veterans' Handicap Chase
super6.comment: Strong-travelling sort who looked as good as ever when winning a couple of veteran events back to back over C&D (this race)/Sandown in a light campaign last season. Has a good record fresh but shaped as if needing his comeback run this time around.

super6.race: Thoroughbred Breeders' Association Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
super6.comment: From the family of Champion Hurdle winner Katchit and improved on her debut form when third of 10 in 2m bumper at Southwell in May, running on to share second past post but subsequently demoted to third for causing interference. Further progress needed in a well-contested race of its type.

super6.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
super6.comment: Made some appeal on paper when fourth of 6 in a maiden at Doncaster 12 days ago, looking the most obviously green of the bunch. Steps up in trip and now switches to all-weather so may show more.

finals.race: Hazelton Mountford Insurance Brokers EBF Fillies' Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Walk In The Park filly. Dam (c94/h103), bumper winner (stayed 3m), half-sister to high-class hurdler/top-class chaser (stayed 21f) Simonsig and winning hurdler/smart chaser (2m-3m winner) Dusart. Plenty to like on paper.

finals.race: Hazelton Mountford Insurance Brokers EBF Fillies' Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Karaktar filly. Dam lightly-raced half-sister to winning hurdler/fairly useful chaser (stayed 3¼m) Azrou d'Ex. Hails from an in-form stable and Champion Jockey Sean Bowen booked to ride.

finals.race: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: From a family connections have had plenty of success with and he looked professional when making a winning start in an 8-runner bumper at Doncaster (17f, soft) on debut, soon clear under just hands-and-heels riding. Leading player making hurdles debut after 8 months off.

finals.race: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: €60,000 3-y-o, Motivator gelding was very green and shaped with only minor promise when third of 6 in bumper at Taunton (2m, good) on debut back in March but can't be dismissed given connections now returning following a breathing operation.

finals.race: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Very promising first effort when ½-length third of 12 to Anthony Honeyball pair at Wincanton 12 months ago but tailed off on both subsequent outings. First-time tongue tie goes on for this return/hurdling debut and he'd be folly to ignore for an in-form handler.

finals.race: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Ran below expectations in a Worcester bumper in September but hinted at ability sent hurdling when seventh of 12 in maiden there (2m) just over 6 weeks ago. Will make little appeal this side of handicaps, though.

finals.race: Great British Bonus Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: £75,000 4-y-o, Walk In The Park mare from family of outstanding chaser Moscow Flyer. Off mark in Irish points a year ago and produced a promising first effort under Rules when second in heavy-ground bumper at Hexham in March. No surprise if she made a big impact on hurdles bow.

finals.race: Denis O'Connell Memorial Veterans' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Dual Grade 2 winner over hurdles and scored at that level on his second chase start at Wincanton 3 years ago. Missed the next 2 years and probably no longer the force of old judged on last season's form, though his excellent record fresh makes him of interest off his reduced mark on return.

finals.race: Denis O'Connell Memorial Veterans' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Strong-travelling sort who looked as good as ever when winning a couple of veteran events back to back over C&D (this race)/Sandown in a light campaign last season. Has a good record fresh but shaped as if needing his comeback run this time around.

finals.race: Denis O'Connell Memorial Veterans' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Fared much better than previously over fences (in 2023) when third at Newbury in December and confirmed that promise 4 months on when winning at Ayr in good style. Remains unexposed as a chaser.

finals.race: Thoroughbred Breeders' Association Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Walk In The Park mare. Half-sister to winning hurdler/fairly useful chaser Sound And Fury and modest hurdler Fiveafterfour, stays 3m. Bought for €100,000 after finishing runner-up only start in Irish points in April 2025 and yard's bumper horses are going well.

finals.race: Thoroughbred Breeders' Association Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: From the family of Champion Hurdle winner Katchit and improved on her debut form when third of 10 in 2m bumper at Southwell in May, running on to share second past post but subsequently demoted to third for causing interference. Further progress needed in a well-contested race of its type.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Made some appeal on paper when fourth of 6 in a maiden at Doncaster 12 days ago, looking the most obviously green of the bunch. Steps up in trip and now switches to all-weather so may show more.

Won twice at Newcastle in 2025 and was second of 11 over C&D in September when not getting a clear run over 1f out. That race is working out pretty well and he's best not judged too harshly on recent effort at York on soft going so could go very well returned to this venue.
